response.sql:
WITH linked AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, e.`aCL IgM` AS acl_igm
    FROM Examination AS e
    INNER JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID
), deviations AS (
    SELECT ID, SEX, acl_igm,
           acl_igm - AVG(acl_igm) OVER () AS deviation
    FROM linked
), scored AS (
    SELECT ID, SEX, acl_igm, deviation,
           deviation - AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY SEX) AS excess
    FROM deviations
)
SELECT ID, SEX, acl_igm AS `aCL IgM`, deviation,
       excess AS `excess above sex average`
FROM scored
WHERE excess > 0
ORDER BY excess DESC
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Each examination is an entry; linked examinations with missing aCL IgM remain in the data but are ignored by the overall and sex-specific averages. A missing SEX is excluded from sex averages because NULL does not form a matching group; blank text is its own group.
